parameters.description_en: The tags that are added to the cloud computer. A tag is a key-value pair that consists of a tag key and a tag value. Tags are used to identify resources. You can use tags to manage cloud computers by group. This facilitates search and batch operations. For more information, see [Use tags to manage cloud computers](~~203781~~).
parameters.description_zh: 标签列表。一个标签由一对键值对组成，用于标记资源。您可以使用标签来分组管理云电脑，便于搜索和批量操作，详情参见[使用标签管理云电脑](~~203781~~)。

element_fields.description_en: The tag key. If you specify the `Tag` parameter, you must also specify the `Key` parameter. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`. The tag key cannot start with `acs:` or `aliyun` and cannot contain only spaces.
element_fields.description_zh: 标签键。如果传入`Tag`，则`Key`是必填的。不可超过128个字符，不能以`aliyun`或`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`，也不能仅包含空格。
